in_marathi.name: Boopathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the path
in_marathi.long_meaning: Boopathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is the lord of the path or the one who protects the path. This name is derived from the Tamil word 'boo' meaning lord and 'pathi' meaning the one who protects or the one who is the leader.
